caption: The drawing depicts a collection of wooden spools arranged on a two-tier circular wooden stand. The spools vary in height and diameter, and most are a natural wood color, with shades ranging from light tan to medium brown. One spool is wound with white thread, while most of the other spools are empty. There are two distinct orange-red spools positioned on the upper tier, contrasting with the overall brown color palette. Thin metal pins are visible through the centers of several spools, suggesting that they are held in place by these pins on the stand. The composition is centered on a plain, beige background, and the artist's signature appears in black ink on the lower right side of the image.
title: Shaker Spool Rack and Spools
